concerns.text: Task T012a implements Welch's PSD on 'continuous 5-minute epochs' using '4-second windows'. This violates Spec FR-003 which mandates 'continuous 5-minute epochs using 4-second windows with [deferred] overlap'. The task description explicitly sets 'config.OVERLAP (0.5, default [deferred] overlap)', effectively hard-coding a 50% overlap value. This is a semantic weakening of the spec's requirement to keep the overlap parameter as a deferred placeholder until empirical validation, violating the 'no silent constitution drift' principle regarding parameter fixation.

Tasks T025a and T025b implement robustness checks separately (T025a: no ICA; T025b: 2s window). Spec FR-008 requires re-running the pipeline with 'an alternative window length... and without ICA cleaning'. The current task breakdown fails to create a single task that combines BOTH conditions (no ICA AND 2s window) to test the specific interaction required by the robustness scenario. This creates a gap where the combined robustness metric (required to verify result stability under alternative parameters) is not generated, violating the acceptance criteria of US-3.

Task T023 (Post-hoc power analysis) is marked as incomplete (`- [ ]`). Spec FR-011 explicitly mandates performing a post-hoc power analysis to estimate sample size for R²=0.10 with power ≥ 0.80. The task's incomplete status means the deliverable for FR-011 is missing, directly violating the requirement that the system MUST perform this analysis. This is a dropped acceptance criterion.

Tasks T025d and T025e are marked incomplete (`- [ ]`). These tasks are required to perform robustness correlation analysis and sensitivity analysis on the robustness dataset (2s window). Spec FR-008 and FR-009 require generating robustness metrics and sensitivity reports. Without these tasks, the 'Robustness Checks' user story is only partially implemented, failing to meet the spec's requirement to 're-run the full analysis pipeline' with alternative parameters.

Task T035b (Contract tests for model results) is marked incomplete (`- [ ]`). Spec SC-001 to SC-004 require reporting specific metrics (Adjusted R², Bonferroni-corrected p-values, etc.). Constitution Principle IV (Single Source of Truth) requires that every result traces back to code and data. Without validated schema contracts (T035b), the integrity of the results files cannot be technically verified, violating the constitutional requirement for data hygiene and traceability.

Tasks T033 (Unit tests) and T036a (Contract tests) are marked incomplete (`- [ ]`). The Plan's 'Compute Feasibility Note' and Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) require the pipeline to be 'runnable end-to-end without manual intervention' and reproducible. The absence of verified unit and contract test runs contradicts the claim of full reproducibility and leaves the pipeline unvalidated, violating the requirement for a fully functional and testable system.
